parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The visibility of the job. Valid values:
- PUBLIC: Visible to all members in the workspace.
- PRIVATE (default): Visible only to you and administrators in the workspace.

parameters.name: BusinessUserId
parameters.description: The user ID associated with the job.

parameters.name: Caller
parameters.description: The caller.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description:
The job name. Supports fuzzy match and is case-insensitive. Wildcards are not supported.
For example, entering test matches test-job1, job-test, job-test2, or job-Test, but does not match job-t1.
Default value: empty, which indicates all job names.

parameters.name: DisplayNameSearchMode
parameters.description: The search mode for DisplayName. Default value: wildcard match.

parameters.name: EnableAssignNode
parameters.description: Filters jobs based on whether running on specified nodes is enabled.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query range. The job creation time is used for filtering. Default value: the current time.

parameters.name: FromAllWorkspaces
parameters.description: Specifies whether to retrieve jobs across all workspaces. This parameter must be used together with `ShowOwn=true` to query jobs recently submitted by the current user.

parameters.name: ImageSearch
parameters.description: Uses full-text index to retrieve the images field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description:
The job ID. Fuzzy match is not supported. Case-insensitive. Wildcards are not supported.
Default value: empty, which indicates all job IDs.

parameters.name: JobIds
parameters.description: A list of job IDs separated by commas. If both JobIds and JobId are specified, JobId takes precedence.

parameters.name: JobType
parameters.description:
The job type. Default value: empty, which indicates all types. Valid values:
- TFJob
- PyTorchJob
- XGBoostJob
- OneFlowJob
- ElasticBatchJob

parameters.name: NumericRangeField
parameters.description: The field name for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeMin or NumericRangeMax.

parameters.name: NumericRangeMax
parameters.description: The maximum value (inclusive) for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeField.

parameters.name: NumericRangeMin
parameters.description: The minimum value (inclusive) for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeField.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- desc: Descending order. This is the default value.
- asc: Ascending order.

parameters.name: OversoldInfo
parameters.description:
The off-peak resource information. Valid values:
- ForbiddenQuotaOverSold
- ForceQuotaOverSold
- AcceptQuotaOverSold-true (true indicates the job actually used off-peak resources)
- AcceptQuotaOverSold-false (false indicates the job actually used guaranteed resources)

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paged query. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1. Paging starts from page 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of jobs to return per page.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:
- PrePaid: resource quota.
- Spot: preemptible resources.
- PostPaid: public resources.

parameters.name: PipelineId
parameters.description: Filters jobs created by the specified pipeline ID.

parameters.name: ReasonSearch
parameters.description: Uses full-text index to retrieve the node failed reason field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. For information about how to obtain the dedicated resource group ID, see [Manage resource quotas](~~2651299~~).

parameters.name: ResourceQuotaName
parameters.description: The name of the resource quota, used to filter the job list. Supports fuzzy match. Wildcards are not supported. Default value: empty, which indicates no filtering by resource quota.

parameters.name: ShowOwn
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only jobs submitted by the current user.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort results. Valid values:

- DisplayName
- JobType
- Status
- GmtCreateTime
- GmtFinishTime

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query range. The job creation time is used for filtering. Default value: the current time minus 7 days. If neither StartTime nor EndTime is specified, jobs created in the last 7 days are returned by default.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The job status. Valid values:
- Creating
- Queuing
- Bidding (currently only for Lingjun Spot jobs)
- EnvPreparing
- SanityChecking
- Running
- Restarting
- Stopping
- SucceededReserving
- FailedReserving
- Succeeded
- Failed
- Stopped

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags used for filtering.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The template ID, used to filter jobs created from the specified template.

parameters.name: TimeRangeField
parameters.description: The time field used for StartTime/EndTime filtering. Default value: creation time.

parameters.name: UserCommandSearch
parameters.description: Uses full-text index to retrieve the user_command field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization.

parameters.name: UserIdForFilter
parameters.description: The user ID of the job submitter, used to filter the job list.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username of the job submitter, used to filter the job list. Supports fuzzy match. Wildcards are not supported. Default value: empty, which indicates no filtering by username.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. <props="china">For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).</props>
